scripts.build:services: npm run build:common && npm run build -w @smart/api-gateway && npm run build -w @smart/auth-service && npm run build -w @smart/catalog-service && npm run build -w @smart/inventory-service && npm run build -w @smart/notification-service && npm run build -w @smart/reporting-service
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build -w @smart/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:common && concurrently -n gateway,auth,catalog,inventory,alerts,reports,web -c cyan,green,blue,magenta,yellow,white,red "npm run dev -w @smart/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @smart/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @smart/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @smart/inventory-service" "npm run dev -w @smart/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @smart/reporting-service" "npm run dev -w @smart/web"
